AbilityDef.label: launch frag grenade
AbilityDef.description: Launch a grenade. Can be reloaded using steel.

AbilityDef.label: launch EMP shell
AbilityDef.description: Launch a shell that releases a burst of electromagnetic energy, stunning mechanical targets. Can be reloaded using steel.

AbilityDef.label: launch smoke shell
AbilityDef.description: Launch a smoke shell that obscures incoming shots and prevents turrets from locking on. Can be reloaded using steel.

AbilityDef.label: launch incendiary shell
AbilityDef.description: Launch a shell that creates an explosion on impact, igniting everything nearby. Can be reloaded using chemfuel.

JobDef.description: Modifying a weapon with a part.
Modifying a weapon with a part.

WeaponTraitDef.label: quick magazine
WeaponTraitDef.description: This magazine uses an improved release mechanism. Reloads are faster, so downtime is shorter.

WeaponTraitDef.label: extended magazine
WeaponTraitDef.description: This magazine holds more ammo than the standard version, letting the weapon fire more shots per burst.

WeaponTraitDef.label: belt magazine
WeaponTraitDef.description: This belt feed provides a steady stream of ammo, allowing longer and more suppressive bursts.

WeaponTraitDef.label: drum magazine
WeaponTraitDef.description: This high-capacity drum holds far more ammo, allowing long and heavy bursts.

WeaponTraitDef.label: shortened stock
WeaponTraitDef.description: A shortened stock that reduces weight. The weapon becomes lighter, more compact, and easier to handle in tight spaces.

WeaponTraitDef.label: telescopic stock
WeaponTraitDef.description: An adjustable stock that improves fit and ergonomics. A steadier stance gives better accuracy.

WeaponTraitDef.label: fold stock
WeaponTraitDef.description: A folding stock with a solid lockup. It provides a stable shoulder rest for accurate fire while also reducing weight a little.

WeaponTraitDef.label: stabilizer brace
WeaponTraitDef.description: A brace that supports the user's arm. It greatly improves stability and short-range accuracy.

WeaponTraitDef.label: rapid trigger
WeaponTraitDef.description: This trigger has a shorter pull and a faster reset. It lets the firing mechanism respond more quickly, increasing the burst rate.

WeaponTraitDef.label: extended barrel
WeaponTraitDef.description: A carefully made extended barrel. It increases muzzle velocity, letting rounds fly farther and improving effective range.

WeaponTraitDef.label: shortened barrel
WeaponTraitDef.description: A shortened barrel. It lowers muzzle velocity and range, but the lighter weight and better balance make the weapon faster to aim.

WeaponTraitDef.label: tactical barrel
WeaponTraitDef.description: A redesigned barrel built for ergonomics and handling. Its lighter profile reduces weight and makes the weapon quicker to steady.

WeaponTraitDef.label: vertical grip
WeaponTraitDef.description: A vertical foregrip that gives the shooter a steadier hold. It improves control and close-range accuracy.

WeaponTraitDef.label: triangular grip
WeaponTraitDef.description: An ergonomic foregrip that improves handling. It helps the shooter ready the weapon faster and steadies point-blank shots.

WeaponTraitDef.label: laser sight
WeaponTraitDef.description: A laser sight that projects a visible dot onto the target. It speeds up aiming and improves accuracy at close to medium range.

WeaponTraitDef.label: grenade launcher
WeaponTraitDef.description: This launcher fires a single high-explosive grenade for strong area damage. It must be reloaded after each shot.

WeaponTraitDef.label: EMP cannon
WeaponTraitDef.description: This launcher fires EMP shells that stun mechanoids and disable electronics. It can fire twice before reloading.

WeaponTraitDef.label: smoke launcher
WeaponTraitDef.description: This launcher fires smoke shells that create a dense cloud on impact. It can fire twice before reloading.

WeaponTraitDef.label: incendiary launcher
WeaponTraitDef.description: This launcher fires a single incendiary shell that spreads fire on impact. It must be reloaded after each shot.

WeaponTraitDef.label: holoscope
WeaponTraitDef.description: An advanced holographic sight. Its clear reticle speeds up target acquisition and improves accuracy at close to medium range.

WeaponTraitDef.label: red dot scope
WeaponTraitDef.description: A red dot sight with a bright aiming point. It simplifies aiming and improves accuracy at all effective ranges.

WeaponTraitDef.label: 2x scope
WeaponTraitDef.description: A 2x optic that makes targets larger and clearer. It helps with precise shots at medium range.

WeaponTraitDef.label: 4x scope
WeaponTraitDef.description: A 4x optic built for medium to long range. It helps identify distant targets and slightly extends effective range.

WeaponTraitDef.label: 8x scope
WeaponTraitDef.description: An 8x optic for long-range precision. Its high magnification helps the shooter hit targets near the weapon's range limit.

WeaponTraitDef.label: heavy rounds
WeaponTraitDef.description: Specialized rounds with heavier bullets. Their stronger impact greatly increases stopping power and slightly improves damage.

WeaponTraitDef.label: hollow point rounds
WeaponTraitDef.description: Hollow point rounds designed to expand on impact. They cause more severe wounds and greatly increase damage.

WeaponTraitDef.label: tox rounds
WeaponTraitDef.description: Rounds coated with a potent toxin. They wound the target and inflict toxic buildup.

WeaponTraitDef.label: piercing rounds
WeaponTraitDef.description: Rounds with a dense, hardened core made to punch through armor. They improve armor penetration.

WeaponTraitDef.label: incendiary rounds
WeaponTraitDef.description: Rounds loaded with an incendiary compound. They burst into flame on impact, causing burns and starting fires.

WeaponTraitDef.label: EMP rounds
WeaponTraitDef.description: Rounds fitted with micro-capacitors. They release an electromagnetic pulse on impact that disrupts electronics and stuns mechanoids.

WeaponTraitDef.label: high power rounds
WeaponTraitDef.description: These rounds use a powerful propellant charge. They deal more damage, hit harder, and penetrate armor better, but the heavier recoil hurts accuracy.

WeaponTraitDef.label: pulse charge rounds
WeaponTraitDef.description: Advanced rounds with an unstable energy cell. They deliver high damage and strong armor penetration.

WeaponTraitDef.label: incendiary pellets
WeaponTraitDef.description: Pellets filled with incendiary material. They scatter burning fragments on impact and are likely to ignite the target.

WeaponTraitDef.label: tox pellets
WeaponTraitDef.description: Pellets filled with toxin. They burst into toxic fragments on impact and quickly build up poison.

WeaponTraitDef.label: birdshot pellets
WeaponTraitDef.description: Small, light pellets that spread in a cone. They are very effective up close, but lose power quickly and struggle against armor.

WeaponTraitDef.label: custom grip
WeaponTraitDef.description: An ergonomic custom grip. It gives better control and improves short-range accuracy.

WeaponTraitDef.label: rapid receiver
WeaponTraitDef.description: This receiver has been finely tuned. Lighter moving parts let the weapon cycle faster and fire bursts more quickly.
